capabilities: Highlight and comment on text in Markdown, PDF, and EPUB readers
Store annotations and reading progress in sidecar JSON files separate from sources
Browse, filter, search, and edit all annotations in a unified sidebar
Export annotation summaries as Markdown with links back to the source text
Read EPUBs with a bundled foliate-js engine and manage a vault reading library
extras: Mobile (Android/iOS) support is pending real-device validation. Annotations live in .obsidian-annotations/ and the README warns to back up that folder with the vault or annotations and progress will be lost. Also installable via BRAT; availability in the community directory depends on automated review.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to annotate PDFs and EPUBs, and annotating Markdown normally means modifying the original document.

relations.evidence: read with the bundled foliate-js engine
obsidian-pdf-plus informed the adapted PDF text-layer offset implementation

summary: Reading and annotation plugin that adds highlights, comments, tags, and reading progress to Markdown, PDF, and EPUB, stored in sidecar JSON files.
